2. Decision Matrix (Choose Once, Never Mix)

Decision Default Choice When to Use Alternative
State equality & copyWith Equatable + manual copyWith Freezed only if used consistently across ALL models & states
Firestore writes Offline-first unawaited writes (client IDs + batch <= 400 ops); server rejections go to WriteErrorBus -> localized SnackBar onCall Cloud Function for billing, quotas, multi-user invariants, and ALL recursive deletes (a board with sub-collections, account data)
Connectivity check (NetworkInfo) Never gate normal Firestore CRUD Always gate onCall Functions, Storage uploads, and deleteAccount
Failure handling Sealed AppFailure -> mapException() / stream.catchFailures() -> failure.localize(context) Never pass raw e.toString(), English strings, or display text (ValidationFailure carries a code) into UI state
Local persistence SharedPreferences ONLY for non-sensitive UI prefs (theme, locale, drafts) flutter_secure_storage for any tokens, secrets, or sensitive local data
Navigation GoRouter with RouteNames + AuthStatus.unknown splash guard Never call Navigator.of(context).push for app routes
Logging & crashes Static AppLogger -> ErrorReporter (Crashlytics on mobile, console/Sentry on web) Never call print() or invoke Crashlytics directly on Web
Functional types fpdart (Either, Right, Left, unit) Never dartz (unmaintained)
Combining auth + profile streams rxdart switchMap Never asyncExpand for endless inner streams — it blocks the next outer event forever

3. The 10 Ironclad Laws (Anti-Patterns)

  1. domain/ is pure Dart. NEVER import flutter/*, cloud_firestore, firebase_auth, or firebase_messaging in domain/.
  2. Every repository method returns Future<Either<AppFailure, T>> or Stream<Either<AppFailure, T>>. Map with mapException() (CancelledException -> FirebaseAuthException -> FirebaseException -> Object). Streams MUST end with .catchFailures(op): try/catch around yield* does NOT catch stream errors.
  3. One state class per feature BLoC. Use enum <Feature>Status { initial, loading, success, failure } + copyWith + AppFailure? failure. Failed refreshes MUST preserve existing data in state. Every emit.forEach has an onError.
  4. NEVER leak StreamSubscriptions. Use emit.forEach / emit.onEach inside BLoC handlers, registered with transformer: restartable() (bloc_concurrency); refresh by add(WatchStarted(...)), never by calling the handler directly. In singleton services (FcmService, ConnectivityCubit, FeatureFlagsCubit), store and cancel all subscriptions in dispose() / close().
  5. Offline-first means NEVER await Firestore write futures (set, update, delete, batch.commit) in normal CRUD. Fire via _fireAndLog(...) (which publishes rejections to WriteErrorBus) and listen via snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: true).
  6. Transactions fail offline. Never call runTransaction on the client for user actions; move transactions to Cloud Functions.
  7. Always withConverter for Firestore reads, and always write updatedAt: FieldValue.serverTimestamp(). Handle nullable Timestamp? locally (?? DateTime.now()).
  8. Zero hardcoded colors, strings, or directional padding. Use Theme.of(context).colorScheme.*, AppLocalizations.of(context), and EdgeInsetsDirectional / AlignmentDirectional for RTL.
  9. Security Rules deny by default & block tampering: - users/{uid} uses an ALLOW-LIST of client fields: keys().hasOnly(...) on create, diff().affectedKeys().hasOnly(...) on update. Privileged fields (isPro, role, plan, boardCount, anything new) are writable ONLY by Admin SDK / Custom Claims. A deny-list (unchanged([...])) alone is NOT enough. - Server timestamps are enforced (updatedAt == request.time); recursive deletes are allow delete: if false + callable Function. - Every tamper rule has a @firebase/rules-unit-testing test, including update paths. - Prevent scraping (allow get: if isSignedIn(); allow list: if false; on publicProfiles). - Validate keys().hasOnly(...) and string/array size() on BOTH create and update. - Notifications are created ONLY by Cloud Functions; Storage rules MUST check firestore.exists(...) before firestore.get(...). - Never use FCM topics for private data: any client can subscribe to any topic. Send to member tokens. - Account deletion erases server data (cleanupDeletedUser on onUserDeleted) — App Store / Google Play requirement.
  10. Zero secrets in client code or --dart-define. Protection = Security Rules + App Check (Play Integrity / App Attest / reCAPTCHA Enterprise enforced on Auth, Firestore, Storage, and onCall Functions) + Hosting CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options headers (templates/firebase.json — verify the CSP on a staging deploy before prod).

5. Exact Startup Sequence (bootstrap.dart)

Every flavor entrypoint (main_dev.dart, main_staging.dart, main_prod.dart) calls AppConfig.init(...) then bootstrap():

  1. WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()
  2. await Firebase.initializeApp(options: AppConfig.instance.firebaseOptions)
  3. await activateAppCheck() (debug in dev; PlayIntegrity / AppAttest / ReCaptchaEnterprise in staging/prod)
  4. Register ErrorReporter (WebErrorReporter on web, CrashlyticsErrorReporter on mobile) + await installGlobalErrorHandlers(reporter)
  5. await configureFirestore() (runs a pending sign-out cache wipe via clearPersistence(), then persistence + 100 MB cache — MUST precede any Firestore call; never terminate() the shared instance at runtime)
  6. await configureDependencies() (sl.init() with @preResolve for SharedPreferences & PackageInfo)
  7. await sl<RemoteConfigService>().init() (activate() cached + unawaited background fetch())
  8. await sl<PerfService>().init() (enabled only in prod)
  9. Register FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler) + setForegroundNotificationPresentationOptions(...)
  10. Bloc.observer = AppBlocObserver()
  11. sl<AuthBloc>().add(const AuthWatchStarted())
  12. runApp(const App())

6. Feature Scaffold Order (Inside-Out)

  1. domain/: Entity (Equatable) -> Repository interface (Either<AppFailure, T>) -> UseCases (UseCase / StreamUseCase + typed Params).
  2. data/: Model (null-safe fromFirestore, ?? DateTime.now(), hasPendingWrites, toMap(), toEntity()) -> Datasource (withConverter, snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: true), unawaited _fireAndLog, cursor pagination) -> RepositoryImpl (maps FirebaseAuthException -> FirebaseException -> AppLogger.error).
  3. presentation/: Single State + enum + copyWith -> Sealed Events -> @injectable BLoC (emit.forEach) -> BlocConsumer UI (ErrorView only when list empty, otherwise AppSnackBar.error).
  4. Routing & Security: RouteNames + createAppRouter (deep links preserved via ?from=) -> firebase/firestore.rules + firebase/firestore.indexes.json -> Cloud Functions if needed.
  5. Tests: Unit tests (UseCases + Repository) -> blocTest -> Widget tests (wrapped with AppLocalizations delegates) -> Emulator integration & Rules unit tests.

7. Mandatory Verification Gate (Run Before Finishing)

flutter gen-l10n
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
flutter analyze

4. Offline-First Firestore + Connectivity (core/firebase/firestore_setup.dart, core/network/*, core/widgets/offline_banner.dart)

// lib/core/firebase/firestore_setup.dart
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

const kPendingCacheWipeKey = 'pending_firestore_cache_wipe';

/// Call in `bootstrap()` BEFORE any other Firestore call.
/// Sign-out only marks the wipe (see `AuthRemoteDatasource.signOut`): calling
/// `terminate()` at runtime would kill the `FirebaseFirestore` instance that
/// GetIt and every datasource already hold. `clearPersistence()` is only legal
/// before the instance starts, so the wipe runs on the next cold start.
Future<void> configureFirestore() async {
  final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  if (prefs.getBool(kPendingCacheWipeKey) ?? false) {
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance.clearPersistence();
    await prefs.remove(kPendingCacheWipeKey);
  }
  FirebaseFirestore.instance.settings = const Settings(
    persistenceEnabled: true,
    cacheSizeBytes: 100 * 1024 * 1024, // 100 MB
  );
}

// lib/core/firebase/write_error_bus.dart
// Offline-first writes are not awaited, so a server rejection (rules, App Check)
// can't be returned to the caller. Publish it here; `App` shows a localized
// SnackBar, so the user knows why an optimistic change disappeared.
@lazySingleton
class WriteErrorBus {
  final _controller = StreamController<AppFailure>.broadcast();
  Stream<AppFailure> get stream => _controller.stream;
  void add(AppFailure failure) {
    if (!_controller.isClosed) _controller.add(failure);
  }

  @disposeMethod
  Future<void> dispose() => _controller.close();
}

// lib/core/errors/stream_failures.dart
// `try/catch` around `yield*` does NOT catch stream errors — they are forwarded
// to the listener. Map every repository stream through `catchFailures`, so the
// BLoC always receives `Left(AppFailure)` instead of a raw exception.
extension EitherStreamX<T> on Stream<Either<AppFailure, T>> {
  Stream<Either<AppFailure, T>> catchFailures(String op) => transform(
        StreamTransformer.fromHandlers(
          handleError: (Object e, StackTrace s, EventSink<Either<AppFailure, T>> sink) =>
              sink.add(Left(mapException(e, s, op))),
        ),
      );
}

AppFailure mapException(Object e, StackTrace s, String op) {
  if (e is CancelledException) return const CancelledFailure(); // user closed the sign-in sheet
  // Order matters: FirebaseAuthException and FirebaseFunctionsException extend FirebaseException.
  if (e is FirebaseAuthException) return e.toFailure();
  if (e is FirebaseException) return e.toFailure();
  AppLogger.error('$op failed', error: e, stack: s);
  return const UnknownFailure('unknown');
}

// lib/core/network/network_info.dart
import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
import 'package:injectable/injectable.dart';

abstract interface class NetworkInfo {
  Future<bool> get isConnected;
  Stream<bool> get onStatusChange;
}

@LazySingleton(as: NetworkInfo)
class NetworkInfoImpl implements NetworkInfo {
  NetworkInfoImpl(this._connectivity);
  final Connectivity _connectivity;

  @override
  Future<bool> get isConnected async => _hasNetwork(await _connectivity.checkConnectivity());

  @override
  Stream<bool> get onStatusChange => _connectivity.onConnectivityChanged.map(_hasNetwork).distinct();

  bool _hasNetwork(List<ConnectivityResult> results) =>
      results.any((r) => r != ConnectivityResult.none);
}

// lib/core/network/connectivity_cubit.dart
@lazySingleton
class ConnectivityCubit extends Cubit<bool> {
  ConnectivityCubit(this._network) : super(true) {
    _sub = _network.onStatusChange.listen(emit);
    unawaited(_network.isConnected.then((online) {
      if (!isClosed) emit(online);
    }));
  }
  final NetworkInfo _network;
  late final StreamSubscription<bool> _sub;

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _sub.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

// lib/core/widgets/offline_banner.dart
class OfflineBanner extends StatelessWidget {
  const OfflineBanner({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cs = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    return BlocBuilder<ConnectivityCubit, bool>(
      builder: (context, online) => AnimatedSize(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
        child: online
            ? const SizedBox(width: double.infinity)
            : Material(
                color: cs.tertiaryContainer,
                child: SafeArea(
                  bottom: false,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
                    child: Row(children: [
                      Icon(Icons.cloud_off_rounded, size: 18, color: cs.onTertiaryContainer),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(l.offlineBanner, style: TextStyle(color: cs.onTertiaryContainer)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

5. Safe Model, Offline Datasource & Repository Impl

// features/boards/data/models/board_model.dart
class BoardModel {
  const BoardModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.color,
    required this.ownerId,
    required this.memberIds,
    required this.updatedAt,
    this.createdAt,
    this.hasPendingWrites = false,
  });

  final String id, title, color, ownerId;
  final List<String> memberIds;
  final DateTime? createdAt;
  final DateTime updatedAt;
  final bool hasPendingWrites;

  factory BoardModel.fromFirestore(DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> doc) {
    final data = doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    return BoardModel(
      id: doc.id,
      title: (data['title'] as String?) ?? '',
      color: (data['color'] as String?) ?? '#6366F1',
      ownerId: (data['ownerId'] as String?) ?? '',
      memberIds: List<String>.from((data['memberIds'] as List?) ?? const []),
      createdAt: (data['createdAt'] as Timestamp?)?.toDate(),
      updatedAt: (data['updatedAt'] as Timestamp?)?.toDate() ?? DateTime.now(),
      hasPendingWrites: doc.metadata.hasPendingWrites,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() => {
        'title': title,
        'color': color,
        'ownerId': ownerId,
        'memberIds': memberIds,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };

  BoardEntity toEntity() => BoardEntity(
        id: id,
        title: title,
        color: color,
        ownerId: ownerId,
        memberIds: memberIds,
        createdAt: createdAt,
        updatedAt: updatedAt,
        hasPendingWrites: hasPendingWrites,
      );
}

// features/boards/data/datasources/boards_remote_datasource.dart
abstract interface class BoardsRemoteDatasource {
  Stream<List<BoardModel>> watchBoards(String userId);
  Future<BoardModel> createBoard(CreateBoardParams params);
  Future<void> updateBoard(String boardId, Map<String, dynamic> data);
  Future<void> deleteBoard(String boardId);
}

@LazySingleton(as: BoardsRemoteDatasource)
class BoardsRemoteDatasourceImpl implements BoardsRemoteDatasource {
  const BoardsRemoteDatasourceImpl(this._firestore, this._functions, this._writeErrors);
  final FirebaseFirestore _firestore;
  final FirebaseFunctions _functions;
  final WriteErrorBus _writeErrors;

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _raw => _firestore.collection('boards');
  CollectionReference<BoardModel> get _boards => _raw.withConverter<BoardModel>(
        fromFirestore: (snap, _) => BoardModel.fromFirestore(snap),
        toFirestore: (model, _) => model.toMap(),
      );

  @override
  Stream<List<BoardModel>> watchBoards(String userId) => _boards
      .where('memberIds', arrayContains: userId)
      .orderBy('updatedAt', descending: true)
      .limit(50)
      .snapshots(includeMetadataChanges: true)
      .map((s) => s.docs.map((d) => d.data()).toList());

  @override
  Future<BoardModel> createBoard(CreateBoardParams params) async {
    final ref = _raw.doc(); // client-generated ID works offline
    final model = BoardModel(
      id: ref.id,
      title: params.title,
      color: params.color,
      ownerId: params.userId,
      memberIds: [params.userId],
      updatedAt: DateTime.now(),
      hasPendingWrites: true,
    );
    _fireAndLog(
      ref.set({...model.toMap(), 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()}),
      'createBoard',
    );
    return model;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> updateBoard(String boardId, Map<String, dynamic> data) async {
    _fireAndLog(
      _raw.doc(boardId).update({...data, 'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()}),
      'updateBoard',
    );
  }

  /// Recursive deletes run server-side (Decision Matrix): a client batch only
  /// sees cached sub-documents when offline and would leave orphaned cards.
  /// The repository gates this call on `NetworkInfo`.
  @override
  Future<void> deleteBoard(String boardId) async {
    await _functions.httpsCallable('deleteBoardRecursive').call<void>({'boardId': boardId});
  }

  void _fireAndLog(Future<void> write, String op) {
    unawaited(write.catchError((Object e, StackTrace s) {
      _writeErrors.add(mapException(e, s, op)); // user sees a localized SnackBar
      AppLogger.error('$op rejected by server', error: e, stack: s);
    }));
  }
}

// features/boards/data/repositories/boards_repository_impl.dart
@LazySingleton(as: BoardsRepository)
class BoardsRepositoryImpl implements BoardsRepository {
  const BoardsRepositoryImpl(this._remote, this._network);
  final BoardsRemoteDatasource _remote;
  final NetworkInfo _network;

  @override
  Stream<Either<AppFailure, List<BoardEntity>>> watchBoards(String userId) => _remote
      .watchBoards(userId)
      .map<Either<AppFailure, List<BoardEntity>>>(
        (models) => Right(models.map((m) => m.toEntity()).toList()),
      )
      .catchFailures('watchBoards');

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, BoardEntity>> createBoard(CreateBoardParams params) async {
    try {
      final model = await _remote.createBoard(params);
      return Right(model.toEntity());
    } catch (e, s) {
      return Left(mapException(e, s, 'createBoard'));
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, Unit>> deleteBoard(String boardId) async {
    if (!await _network.isConnected) return const Left(NetworkFailure());
    try {
      await _remote.deleteBoard(boardId);
      return const Right(unit);
    } catch (e, s) {
      return Left(mapException(e, s, 'deleteBoard'));
    }
  }
}

6. Cursor Pagination, Storage Service, DraftStore, Fractional Ordering & Sign-Out Wipe

// Cursor pagination
class PaginatedResult<T> {
  const PaginatedResult({required this.items, required this.hasMore, this.cursor});
  final List<T> items;
  final bool hasMore;
  final Object? cursor;
}

Future<PaginatedResult<ActivityModel>> fetchActivityPage({
  required String boardId,
  Object? cursor,
  int pageSize = 25,
}) async {
  var q = _firestore
      .collection('boards').doc(boardId).collection('activity')
      .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
      .limit(pageSize);
  if (cursor is DocumentSnapshot) q = q.startAfterDocument(cursor);
  final snap = await q.get();
  return PaginatedResult(
    items: snap.docs.map(ActivityModel.fromFirestore).toList(),
    hasMore: snap.docs.length == pageSize,
    cursor: snap.docs.isEmpty ? cursor : snap.docs.last,
  );
}

// lib/core/storage/storage_service.dart
@lazySingleton
class StorageService {
  StorageService(this._storage, this._perf);
  final FirebaseStorage _storage;
  final PerfService _perf;

  Future<String> uploadBytes({
    required String path,
    required Uint8List bytes,
    required String contentType,
    void Function(double progress)? onProgress,
  }) =>
      _perf.trace('storage_upload', () async {
        final ref = _storage.ref(path);
        final task = ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: contentType));
        final sub = task.snapshotEvents.listen((s) {
          if (s.totalBytes > 0) onProgress?.call(s.bytesTransferred / s.totalBytes);
        });
        try {
          await task;
          return await ref.getDownloadURL();
        } finally {
          await sub.cancel();
        }
      }, attributes: {'size_bucket': bytes.length < 1048576 ? '<1MB' : '>=1MB'});

  Future<void> delete(String path) => _storage.ref(path).delete();
}

// lib/core/storage/draft_store.dart (non-sensitive UI drafts only; use FlutterSecureStorage for secrets)
@lazySingleton
class DraftStore {
  DraftStore(this._prefs);
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  String? read(String cardId) => _prefs.getString('draft_$cardId');
  Future<void> save(String cardId, String text) => _prefs.setString('draft_$cardId', text);
  Future<void> clear(String cardId) => _prefs.remove('draft_$cardId');
}

// Fractional ordering (drag-and-drop updates ONE document)
double positionBetween(double? before, double? after) {
  if (before == null && after == null) return 1000;
  if (before == null) return after! - 1000;
  if (after == null) return before + 1000;
  return (before + after) / 2;
}

// Sign-out local persistence wipe: mark it, never `terminate()` the shared instance.
// `configureFirestore()` clears the cache on the next cold start.
// High-sensitivity apps (shared devices, fintech): restart the process right after
// sign-out so the wipe happens immediately.
Future<void> signOutAndMarkCacheWipe(FirebaseAuth auth, SharedPreferences prefs) async {
  await prefs.setBool(kPendingCacheWipeKey, true);
  await auth.signOut();
}

1. UserEntity, UserModel & AuthRepository

// features/auth/domain/entities/user_entity.dart
class UserEntity extends Equatable {
  const UserEntity({
    required this.id,
    this.name,
    this.email,
    this.phone,
    this.photoUrl,
    this.username,
    this.isPro = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final String? name, email, phone, photoUrl, username;
  final bool isPro;

  bool get needsOnboarding => username == null || username!.isEmpty;

  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [id, name, email, phone, photoUrl, username, isPro];
}

// features/auth/data/models/user_model.dart
class UserModel {
  const UserModel({
    required this.id,
    this.name,
    this.email,
    this.phone,
    this.photoUrl,
    this.username,
    this.isPro = false,
  });

  final String id;
  final String? name, email, phone, photoUrl, username;
  final bool isPro;

  factory UserModel.fromFirestore(DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> doc) {
    final d = doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    return UserModel(
      id: doc.id,
      name: d['name'] as String?,
      email: d['email'] as String?,
      phone: d['phone'] as String?,
      photoUrl: d['photoUrl'] as String?,
      username: d['username'] as String?,
      isPro: (d['isPro'] as bool?) ?? false,
    );
  }

  factory UserModel.fromFirebaseUser(User u) => UserModel(
        id: u.uid,
        name: u.displayName,
        email: u.email,
        phone: u.phoneNumber,
        photoUrl: u.photoURL,
      );

  UserEntity toEntity() => UserEntity(
        id: id,
        name: name,
        email: email,
        phone: phone,
        photoUrl: photoUrl,
        username: username,
        isPro: isPro,
      );
}

2. Complete AuthRemoteDatasourceImpl (All Auth Methods + Delete Account)

// imports: package:rxdart/rxdart.dart (switchMap, onErrorReturnWith),
// package:google_sign_in/google_sign_in.dart (v7 API), package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart
@LazySingleton(as: AuthRemoteDatasource)
class AuthRemoteDatasourceImpl implements AuthRemoteDatasource {
  AuthRemoteDatasourceImpl(this._auth, this._firestore, this._prefs);
  final FirebaseAuth _auth;
  final FirebaseFirestore _firestore;
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  Future<void>? _googleInit;

  /// `switchMap` (NOT `asyncExpand`): `asyncExpand` waits for the inner
  /// `snapshots()` stream to finish before handling the next auth event, and
  /// that stream never finishes — so sign-out (`null`) would never arrive.
  /// `switchMap` cancels the previous user's listener on every auth change.
  @override
  Stream<UserModel?> watchAuthState() => _auth.authStateChanges().switchMap((user) {
        if (user == null) return Stream<UserModel?>.value(null);
        return _firestore
            .collection('users')
            .doc(user.uid)
            .snapshots()
            .map<UserModel?>(
              (doc) => doc.exists ? UserModel.fromFirestore(doc) : UserModel.fromFirebaseUser(user),
            )
            // Profile read failed (e.g. rules, offline first launch): stay signed in with Auth data.
            .onErrorReturnWith((Object e, StackTrace s) {
              AppLogger.error('watch user profile failed', error: e, stack: s);
              return UserModel.fromFirebaseUser(user);
            });
      });

  // google_sign_in 7.x: initialize() exactly once before any other call.
  Future<void> _ensureGoogleInit() => _googleInit ??= GoogleSignIn.instance.initialize(
        serverClientId: AppConfig.instance.googleServerClientId, // null on Android = read from google-services.json
      );

  @override
  Future<UserModel> signInWithGoogle() async {
    if (kIsWeb) {
      // GoogleSignIn.authenticate() is not supported on web; use the Firebase popup flow.
      final cred = await _auth.signInWithPopup(GoogleAuthProvider());
      return _upsertUser(cred.user!);
    }
    await _ensureGoogleInit();
    final GoogleSignInAccount account;
    try {
      account = await GoogleSignIn.instance.authenticate(scopeHint: const ['email']);
    } on GoogleSignInException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == GoogleSignInExceptionCode.canceled) throw const CancelledException();
      rethrow;
    }
    final idToken = account.authentication.idToken; // v7: ID token only, no access token
    final cred = await _auth.signInWithCredential(GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken: idToken));
    return _upsertUser(cred.user!);
  }

  @override
  Future<UserModel> signInWithApple() async {
    final rawNonce = generateNonce();
    final sha256Nonce = sha256.convert(utf8.encode(rawNonce)).toString();
    final AuthorizationCredentialAppleID appleCred;
    try {
      appleCred = await SignInWithApple.getAppleIDCredential(
        scopes: [AppleIDAuthorizationScopes.email, AppleIDAuthorizationScopes.fullName],
        nonce: sha256Nonce,
      );
    } on SignInWithAppleAuthorizationException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == AuthorizationErrorCode.canceled) throw const CancelledException();
      rethrow;
    }
    final cred = await _auth.signInWithCredential(
      OAuthProvider('apple.com').credential(idToken: appleCred.identityToken, rawNonce: rawNonce),
    );
    final name = [appleCred.givenName, appleCred.familyName].whereType<String>().join(' ').trim();
    return _upsertUser(cred.user!, displayName: name.isEmpty ? null : name);
  }

  @override
  Future<String> sendOtp(String phoneNumber) {
    final completer = Completer<String>();
    unawaited(_auth.verifyPhoneNumber(
      phoneNumber: phoneNumber,
      timeout: const Duration(seconds: 60),
      verificationCompleted: (_) {},
      verificationFailed: (e) {
        if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.completeError(e);
      },
      codeSent: (id, _) {
        if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.complete(id);
      },
      codeAutoRetrievalTimeout: (_) {},
    ));
    return completer.future;
  }

  @override
  Future<UserModel> verifyOtp({required String verificationId, required String otp}) async {
    final cred = await _auth.signInWithCredential(
      PhoneAuthProvider.credential(verificationId: verificationId, smsCode: otp.trim()),
    );
    return _upsertUser(cred.user!);
  }

  @override
  Future<UserModel> signInWithEmail({required String email, required String password}) async {
    final cred = await _auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email: email.trim(), password: password);
    return _upsertUser(cred.user!);
  }

  @override
  Future<UserModel> signUpWithEmail({required String email, required String password}) async {
    final cred = await _auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email: email.trim(), password: password);
    return _upsertUser(cred.user!);
  }

  @override
  Future<void> sendPasswordReset(String email) =>
      _auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(email: email.trim());

  /// Throws FirebaseAuthException('requires-recent-login') if the session is old:
  /// the UI must re-authenticate (Google/Apple/OTP again) and retry.
  /// Server data is erased by the `cleanupDeletedUser` Cloud Function (notifications-and-links.md §4).
  @override
  Future<void> deleteAccount() async {
    final user = _auth.currentUser;
    if (user == null) return;
    await user.delete();
    await _afterSessionEnd();
  }

  @override
  Future<void> signOut() async {
    await _auth.signOut();
    await _afterSessionEnd();
  }

  Future<void> _afterSessionEnd() async {
    // Never `terminate()` here: GetIt and every datasource hold this Firestore instance.
    await _prefs.setBool(kPendingCacheWipeKey, true); // cleared on next cold start
    if (!kIsWeb && _googleInit != null) {
      await GoogleSignIn.instance.signOut().catchError((Object _) {});
    }
  }

  Future<UserModel> _upsertUser(User user, {String? displayName}) async {
    final ref = _firestore.collection('users').doc(user.uid);
    // Note: Never send `isPro`, `role`, or `boardCount` from client — Security Rules block them.
    await ref.set({
      'id': user.uid,
      'name': displayName ?? user.displayName,
      'email': user.email,
      'phone': user.phoneNumber,
      'photoUrl': user.photoURL,
      'lastSignIn': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    return UserModel.fromFirestore(await ref.get());
  }
}

2b. AuthRepositoryImpl (Stream Errors Mapped, Network-Gated Delete)

@LazySingleton(as: AuthRepository)
class AuthRepositoryImpl implements AuthRepository {
  const AuthRepositoryImpl(this._remote, this._network);
  final AuthRemoteDatasource _remote;
  final NetworkInfo _network;

  @override
  Stream<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity?>> watchAuthState() => _remote
      .watchAuthState()
      .map<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity?>>((m) => Right(m?.toEntity()))
      .catchFailures('watchAuthState');

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity>> signInWithGoogle() => _guard('signInWithGoogle', _remote.signInWithGoogle);

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity>> signInWithApple() => _guard('signInWithApple', _remote.signInWithApple);

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, Unit>> deleteAccount() async {
    if (!await _network.isConnected) return const Left(NetworkFailure()); // Decision Matrix: always gate
    try {
      await _remote.deleteAccount();
      return const Right(unit);
    } catch (e, s) {
      return Left(mapException(e, s, 'deleteAccount')); // 'requires-recent-login' -> AuthFailure
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<AppFailure, Unit>> signOut() async {
    try {
      await _remote.signOut();
      return const Right(unit);
    } catch (e, s) {
      return Left(mapException(e, s, 'signOut'));
    }
  }

  Future<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity>> _guard(String op, Future<UserModel> Function() call) async {
    try {
      return Right((await call()).toEntity());
    } catch (e, s) {
      return Left(mapException(e, s, op)); // CancelledException -> CancelledFailure (no SnackBar)
    }
  }
}

3. Complete AuthBloc (AuthStatus.unknown Splash Guard)

enum AuthStatus { unknown, authenticated, unauthenticated, loading, failure }

class AuthState extends Equatable {
  const AuthState({
    this.status = AuthStatus.unknown,
    this.user,
    this.verificationId,
    this.failure,
  });

  final AuthStatus status;
  final UserEntity? user;
  final String? verificationId;
  final AppFailure? failure;

  AuthState copyWith({
    AuthStatus? status,
    UserEntity? Function()? user,
    String? verificationId,
    AppFailure? Function()? failure,
  }) =>
      AuthState(
        status: status ?? this.status,
        user: user != null ? user() : this.user,
        verificationId: verificationId ?? this.verificationId,
        failure: failure != null ? failure() : this.failure,
      );

  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [status, user, verificationId, failure];
}

sealed class AuthEvent extends Equatable {
  const AuthEvent();
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [];
}

class AuthWatchStarted extends AuthEvent { const AuthWatchStarted(); }
class GoogleSignInRequested extends AuthEvent { const GoogleSignInRequested(); }
class AppleSignInRequested extends AuthEvent { const AppleSignInRequested(); }
class SignOutRequested extends AuthEvent { const SignOutRequested(); }
class DeleteAccountRequested extends AuthEvent { const DeleteAccountRequested(); }

@lazySingleton
class AuthBloc extends Bloc<AuthEvent, AuthState> {
  AuthBloc(this._repo, this._fcm, this._reporter) : super(const AuthState()) {
    on<AuthWatchStarted>(_onWatch);
    on<GoogleSignInRequested>(_onGoogle);
    on<AppleSignInRequested>(_onApple);
    on<SignOutRequested>(_onSignOut);
    on<DeleteAccountRequested>(_onDeleteAccount);
  }
  final AuthRepository _repo;
  final FcmService _fcm;
  final ErrorReporter _reporter;

  Future<void> _onWatch(AuthWatchStarted _, Emitter<AuthState> emit) => emit.forEach(
        _repo.watchAuthState(), // Stream<Either<AppFailure, UserEntity?>> mapped with catchFailures
        onData: (result) => result.fold(
          (f) => state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.failure, failure: () => f),
          (user) {
            unawaited(_reporter.setUser(user?.id));
            if (user != null) unawaited(_fcm.initialize(user.id)); // idempotent per uid
            return user == null
                ? const AuthState(status: AuthStatus.unauthenticated)
                : AuthState(status: AuthStatus.authenticated, user: user);
          },
        ),
        onError: (e, s) => state.copyWith(
          status: AuthStatus.failure,
          failure: () => const UnknownFailure('auth-stream'),
        ),
      );

  Future<void> _onGoogle(GoogleSignInRequested _, Emitter<AuthState> emit) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.loading, failure: () => null));
    final res = await _repo.signInWithGoogle();
    res.fold(
      (f) => emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.failure, failure: () => f)),
      (_) {},
    );
  }

  Future<void> _onApple(AppleSignInRequested _, Emitter<AuthState> emit) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.loading, failure: () => null));
    final res = await _repo.signInWithApple();
    res.fold(
      (f) => emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.failure, failure: () => f)),
      (_) {},
    );
  }

  Future<void> _onSignOut(SignOutRequested _, Emitter<AuthState> emit) async {
    final uid = state.user?.id;
    if (uid != null) await _fcm.removeToken(uid); // needs auth: run BEFORE signOut
    _fcm.dispose();
    await _repo.signOut(); // auth stream emits null -> unauthenticated
  }

  Future<void> _onDeleteAccount(DeleteAccountRequested _, Emitter<AuthState> emit) async {
    // `user` is kept in state, so the router keeps the user on the current screen.
    emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.loading, failure: () => null));
    final res = await _repo.deleteAccount(); // requires network: repository gates on NetworkInfo
    await res.fold(
      // e.g. AuthFailure('requires-recent-login') -> UI re-authenticates and retries
      (f) async => emit(state.copyWith(status: AuthStatus.failure, failure: () => f)),
      (_) async {
        _fcm.dispose();
        await _fcm.deleteLocalToken(); // user doc + tokens are erased server-side
      },
    );
  }
}

4. App Check (lib/core/firebase/app_check_setup.dart)

// firebase_app_check 0.5.x: provider objects (the old androidProvider/appleProvider/
// webProvider enum parameters were removed in 0.5.0).
Future<void> activateAppCheck() {
  final dev = AppConfig.instance.isDev;
  return FirebaseAppCheck.instance.activate(
    providerAndroid: dev ? AndroidDebugProvider() : AndroidPlayIntegrityProvider(),
    providerApple: dev ? AppleDebugProvider() : AppleAppAttestWithDeviceCheckFallbackProvider(),
    providerWeb: ReCaptchaEnterpriseProvider(AppConfig.instance.recaptchaSiteKey),
  );
}

5. Hardened Firestore & Storage Rules (firebase/firestore.rules, firebase/storage.rules)

// firebase/firestore.rules
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function isSignedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
    function isOwner(userId) { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid == userId; }
    function isMember(data) { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid in data.memberIds; }
    function boardData(boardId) { return get(/databases/$(database)/documents/boards/$(boardId)).data; }
    function incoming() { return request.resource.data; }
    function changed() { return incoming().diff(resource.data).affectedKeys(); }
    function unchanged(fields) { return !changed().hasAny(fields); }
    function onlyChanges(fields) { return changed().hasOnly(fields); }
    function optString(d, k, max) { return !(k in d) || d[k] == null || (d[k] is string && d[k].size() <= max); }
    function stampedNow(field) { return incoming()[field] == request.time; } // FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

    // ---- users/{uid}: an ALLOW-LIST of client fields. Everything else (isPro, role, plan,
    // boardCount, credits, ...) can only be written by the Admin SDK / Cloud Functions.
    function userClientFields() {
      return ['id', 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'photoUrl', 'username', 'lastSignIn',
              'fcmTokens', 'notificationsEnabled', 'lastTokenUpdatedAt'];
    }
    function validUser(d) {
      return optString(d, 'name', 100) && optString(d, 'email', 254) && optString(d, 'phone', 20)
        && optString(d, 'photoUrl', 2048) && optString(d, 'username', 30)
        && (!('fcmTokens' in d) || (d.fcmTokens is list && d.fcmTokens.size() <= 10))
        && (!('notificationsEnabled' in d) || d.notificationsEnabled is bool);
    }
    match /users/{userId} {
      allow read: if isOwner(userId);
      allow create: if isOwner(userId) && incoming().id == userId
        && incoming().keys().hasOnly(userClientFields()) && validUser(incoming());
      // affectedKeys().hasOnly(): server-owned fields already in the doc stay untouched.
      allow update: if isOwner(userId) && onlyChanges(userClientFields())
        && unchanged(['id']) && validUser(incoming());
      allow delete: if false; // `cleanupDeletedUser` Cloud Function only
    }

    match /publicProfiles/{userId} {
      allow get: if isSignedIn();
      allow list: if false; // anti-scraping
      allow create, update: if isOwner(userId) && incoming().keys().hasOnly(['name', 'photoUrl', 'username'])
        && optString(incoming(), 'name', 100) && optString(incoming(), 'photoUrl', 2048)
        && optString(incoming(), 'username', 30);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    function validBoard(d) {
      return d.keys().hasOnly(['title', 'color', 'ownerId', 'memberIds', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'])
        && d.title is string && d.title.size() >= 1 && d.title.size() <= 120
        && d.color is string && d.color.size() <= 16
        && d.memberIds is list && d.memberIds.size() <= 50 && d.ownerId in d.memberIds
        && d.createdAt is timestamp && d.updatedAt is timestamp;
    }
    match /boards/{boardId} {
      allow read: if isMember(resource.data);
      allow create: if isSignedIn() && incoming().ownerId == request.auth.uid
        && incoming().memberIds == [request.auth.uid]
        && stampedNow('createdAt') && stampedNow('updatedAt') && validBoard(incoming());
      allow update: if isMember(resource.data) && unchanged(['ownerId', 'createdAt'])
        && (isOwner(resource.data.ownerId) || unchanged(['memberIds']))
        && stampedNow('updatedAt') && validBoard(incoming());
      allow delete: if false; // `deleteBoardRecursive` callable (Admin SDK) only

      function validCard(d) {
        return d.keys().hasOnly(['title', 'description', 'position', 'assigneeId', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'])
          && d.title is string && d.title.size() >= 1 && d.title.size() <= 200
          && optString(d, 'description', 5000)
          && d.position is number
          && (!('assigneeId' in d) || d.assigneeId == null || d.assigneeId in boardData(boardId).memberIds);
      }
      match /cards/{cardId} {
        allow read: if isMember(boardData(boardId));
        allow create: if isMember(boardData(boardId)) && stampedNow('createdAt') && stampedNow('updatedAt')
          && validCard(incoming());
        allow update: if isMember(boardData(boardId)) && unchanged(['createdAt']) && stampedNow('updatedAt')
          && validCard(incoming());
        allow delete: if isMember(boardData(boardId));
      }
    }

    match /notifications/{notifId} {
      allow read: if isOwner(resource.data.userId); // list queries must filter where('userId', '==', uid)
      allow update: if isOwner(resource.data.userId) && onlyChanges(['isRead']) && incoming().isRead is bool;
      allow create, delete: if false; // Cloud Functions only
    }
  }
}

// firebase/storage.rules
rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    function isBoardMember(boardId) {
      return request.auth != null
        && firestore.exists(/databases/(default)/documents/boards/$(boardId))
        && request.auth.uid in firestore.get(/databases/(default)/documents/boards/$(boardId)).data.memberIds;
    }
    match /boards/{boardId}/attachments/{fileName} {
      allow read: if isBoardMember(boardId);
      allow create, update: if isBoardMember(boardId)
        && request.resource.size < 10 * 1024 * 1024
        && request.resource.contentType.matches('image/(png|jpeg|webp|gif)|application/pdf');
      allow delete: if isBoardMember(boardId);
    }
    match /users/{userId}/avatar.jpg {
      allow read: if request.auth != null;
      allow create, update: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.size < 5 * 1024 * 1024
        && request.resource.contentType.matches('image/(png|jpeg|webp)');
      allow delete: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }
    match /{allPaths=**} { allow read, write: if false; }
  }
}

6. Security Rules Automated Tests (firebase/tests/rules.test.ts)

Run with the emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "npx vitest run firebase/tests". Every rule that blocks tampering gets a test that proves it — especially update paths, where most privilege escalations happen.

import { assertFails, assertSucceeds, initializeTestEnvironment, RulesTestEnvironment } from '@firebase/rules-unit-testing';
import { serverTimestamp, doc, setDoc, updateDoc, getDoc, getDocs, collection, addDoc, deleteDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, it } from 'vitest';

let env: RulesTestEnvironment;

beforeAll(async () => {
  env = await initializeTestEnvironment({
    projectId: 'demo-rules',
    firestore: { rules: readFileSync('firebase/firestore.rules', 'utf8') },
  });
});
afterAll(() => env.cleanup());
beforeEach(async () => {
  await env.clearFirestore();
  await env.withSecurityRulesDisabled(async (ctx) => {
    const db = ctx.firestore();
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'users/alice'), { id: 'alice', name: 'Alice', isPro: false });
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'boards/b1'), {
      title: 'Board', color: '#6366F1', ownerId: 'alice', memberIds: ['alice', 'bob'],
      createdAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
    await setDoc(doc(db, 'notifications/n1'), { userId: 'alice', title: 'Hi', isRead: false });
  });
});

const as = (uid: string) => env.authenticatedContext(uid).firestore();

describe('users/{uid}', () => {
  it('allows creating an own profile with client fields only', async () => {
    await assertSucceeds(setDoc(doc(as('carol'), 'users/carol'), { id: 'carol', name: 'Carol' }));
  });
  it('blocks privileged fields on create', async () => {
    await assertFails(setDoc(doc(as('carol'), 'users/carol'), { id: 'carol', isPro: true }));
    await assertFails(setDoc(doc(as('carol'), 'users/carol'), { id: 'carol', plan: 'enterprise' }));
  });
  it('blocks privilege escalation on update (isPro, role, plan, any unknown field)', async () => {
    const db = as('alice');
    for (const field of ['isPro', 'role', 'plan', 'boardCount', 'anythingElse']) {
      await assertFails(updateDoc(doc(db, 'users/alice'), { [field]: true }));
    }
  });
  it('allows updating client fields', async () => {
    await assertSucceeds(updateDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'users/alice'), { name: 'Alice B.' }));
  });
  it('blocks oversized values and other users', async () => {
    await assertFails(updateDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'users/alice'), { name: 'x'.repeat(101) }));
    await assertFails(getDoc(doc(as('bob'), 'users/alice')));
    await assertFails(deleteDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'users/alice')));
  });
});

describe('publicProfiles', () => {
  it('blocks listing (anti-scraping)', async () => {
    await assertFails(getDocs(collection(as('alice'), 'publicProfiles')));
  });
});

describe('boards', () => {
  const board = (uid: string, memberIds: string[]) => ({
    title: 'New', color: '#000000', ownerId: uid, memberIds,
    createdAt: serverTimestamp(), updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  });
  it('allows creating an own board', async () => {
    await assertSucceeds(setDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'boards/b2'), board('alice', ['alice'])));
  });
  it('blocks adding other members or a foreign owner on create', async () => {
    await assertFails(setDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'boards/b3'), board('alice', ['alice', 'mallory'])));
    await assertFails(setDoc(doc(as('mallory'), 'boards/b4'), board('alice', ['alice'])));
  });
  it('blocks non-members and ownership hijacking', async () => {
    await assertFails(getDoc(doc(as('mallory'), 'boards/b1')));
    await assertFails(updateDoc(doc(as('bob'), 'boards/b1'), { ownerId: 'bob', updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }));
    await assertFails(updateDoc(doc(as('bob'), 'boards/b1'), { memberIds: ['alice', 'bob', 'mallory'], updatedAt: serverTimestamp() }));
  });
  it('blocks client-side board deletes (callable only)', async () => {
    await assertFails(deleteDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'boards/b1')));
  });
});

describe('notifications', () => {
  it('blocks forged notifications and allows marking own as read', async () => {
    await assertFails(addDoc(collection(as('alice'), 'notifications'), { userId: 'alice', title: 'fake' }));
    await assertFails(updateDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'notifications/n1'), { title: 'edited' }));
    await assertSucceeds(updateDoc(doc(as('alice'), 'notifications/n1'), { isRead: true }));
  });
});

firebase/tests/package.json dev dependencies: @firebase/rules-unit-testing, firebase, vitest, typescript.

7. High-Sensitivity Apps (Fintech / Enterprise)

  • Store local sensitive data only via FlutterSecureStorage (never SharedPreferences).
  • Restart the app process right after sign-out so the pending Firestore cache wipe runs immediately (shared devices).
  • Add RASP / Root / Jailbreak / Frida detection (freerasp) + FLAG_SECURE on sensitive screens.
  • Enforce App Check in Firebase Console on Auth, Firestore, Storage, AND Functions, and enable Email Enumeration Protection.

BLoC, Errors, Theme, Adaptive UI & RTL Localization (Complete Code)

1. Single-State BLoC + Events + UI (BoardsBloc)

enum BoardsStatus { initial, loading, success, failure }

class BoardsState extends Equatable {
  const BoardsState({
    this.status = BoardsStatus.initial,
    this.boards = const [],
    this.failure,
  });
  final BoardsStatus status;
  final List<BoardEntity> boards;
  final AppFailure? failure;

  BoardsState copyWith({
    BoardsStatus? status,
    List<BoardEntity>? boards,
    AppFailure? Function()? failure,
  }) =>
      BoardsState(
        status: status ?? this.status,
        boards: boards ?? this.boards,
        failure: failure != null ? failure() : this.failure,
      );

  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [status, boards, failure];
}

sealed class BoardsEvent extends Equatable {
  const BoardsEvent();
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [];
}
class WatchBoardsStarted extends BoardsEvent {
  const WatchBoardsStarted(this.userId);
  final String userId;
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [userId];
}
class BoardsRefreshed extends BoardsEvent { const BoardsRefreshed(); }
class CreateBoardRequested extends BoardsEvent {
  const CreateBoardRequested({required this.title, required this.color, required this.userId});
  final String title, color, userId;
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [title, color, userId];
}
class DeleteBoardRequested extends BoardsEvent {
  const DeleteBoardRequested(this.boardId);
  final String boardId;
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [boardId];
}

// import 'package:bloc_concurrency/bloc_concurrency.dart';
@injectable
class BoardsBloc extends Bloc<BoardsEvent, BoardsState> {
  BoardsBloc(this._watchBoards, this._createBoard, this._deleteBoard) : super(const BoardsState()) {
    // restartable(): a new WatchBoardsStarted cancels the previous emit.forEach subscription.
    // Without it, every refresh would add one more live Firestore listener (leak).
    on<WatchBoardsStarted>(_onWatchStarted, transformer: restartable());
    on<BoardsRefreshed>(_onRefreshed);
    on<CreateBoardRequested>(_onCreateBoard);
    on<DeleteBoardRequested>(_onDeleteBoard);
  }
  final WatchBoards _watchBoards;
  final CreateBoard _createBoard;
  final DeleteBoard _deleteBoard;
  String? _userId;

  Future<void> _onWatchStarted(WatchBoardsStarted e, Emitter<BoardsState> emit) async {
    _userId = e.userId;
    emit(state.copyWith(status: BoardsStatus.loading));
    await emit.forEach(
      _watchBoards(e.userId), // repository maps stream errors to Left(AppFailure)
      onData: (result) => result.fold(
        // boards are NOT cleared: a failed refresh keeps the last data on screen
        (f) => state.copyWith(status: BoardsStatus.failure, failure: () => f),
        (b) => state.copyWith(status: BoardsStatus.success, boards: b, failure: () => null),
      ),
      // Safety net: never leave the UI stuck in `loading` if something unmapped escapes.
      onError: (_, __) => state.copyWith(
        status: BoardsStatus.failure,
        failure: () => const UnknownFailure('watch-boards'),
      ),
    );
  }

  // Re-dispatch instead of calling the handler directly: the event goes through
  // the restartable() transformer, which cancels the old listener first.
  void _onRefreshed(BoardsRefreshed _, Emitter<BoardsState> emit) {
    final uid = _userId;
    if (uid != null) add(WatchBoardsStarted(uid));
  }

  Future<void> _onCreateBoard(CreateBoardRequested e, Emitter<BoardsState> emit) async {
    final res = await _createBoard(CreateBoardParams(title: e.title, color: e.color, userId: e.userId));
    res.fold((f) => emit(state.copyWith(status: BoardsStatus.failure, failure: () => f)), (_) {});
  }

  Future<void> _onDeleteBoard(DeleteBoardRequested e, Emitter<BoardsState> emit) async {
    final res = await _deleteBoard(e.boardId);
    res.fold((f) => emit(state.copyWith(status: BoardsStatus.failure, failure: () => f)), (_) {});
  }
}

// UI Usage (keep boards on screen if a refresh fails)
BlocConsumer<BoardsBloc, BoardsState>(
  listenWhen: (p, c) =>
      c.failure != null && p.failure != c.failure &&
      c.boards.isNotEmpty && c.failure is! CancelledFailure,
  listener: (context, s) => AppSnackBar.error(context, s.failure!.localize(context)),
  builder: (context, s) => switch (s) {
    BoardsState(status: BoardsStatus.loading, boards: []) => const AppShimmer(),
    BoardsState(status: BoardsStatus.failure, boards: [], :final failure?) => ErrorView(
        failure: failure,
        onRetry: () => context.read<BoardsBloc>().add(const BoardsRefreshed()),
      ),
    BoardsState(boards: []) => const AppEmptyState(),
    BoardsState(:final boards) => BoardsGrid(boards: boards),
  },
);

2. AppBlocObserver (lib/core/observers/app_bloc_observer.dart)

class AppBlocObserver extends BlocObserver {
  @override
  void onEvent(Bloc<dynamic, dynamic> bloc, Object? event) {
    super.onEvent(bloc, event);
    AppLogger.info('EVENT: $event', tag: '${bloc.runtimeType}');
  }

  @override
  void onTransition(Bloc<dynamic, dynamic> bloc, Transition<dynamic, dynamic> transition) {
    super.onTransition(bloc, transition);
    AppLogger.info(
      '${transition.currentState.runtimeType} -> ${transition.nextState.runtimeType}',
      tag: '${bloc.runtimeType}',
    );
  }

  @override
  void onError(BlocBase<dynamic> bloc, Object error, StackTrace stackTrace) {
    AppLogger.error('BLoC ${bloc.runtimeType}', error: error, stack: stackTrace);
    unawaited(sl<ErrorReporter>().record(error, stackTrace, reason: 'BLoC ${bloc.runtimeType}'));
    super.onError(bloc, error, stackTrace);
  }
}

3. Complete Error Handling (failures.dart, exception_mapper.dart, failure_l10n.dart, error_reporter.dart, global_error_handlers.dart, app_logger.dart, error_view.dart, app_snack_bar.dart, friendly_error_widget.dart)

// failures.dart
sealed class AppFailure extends Equatable {
  const AppFailure(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [message];
}
final class NetworkFailure extends AppFailure { const NetworkFailure() : super('network'); }
final class PermissionFailure extends AppFailure { const PermissionFailure() : super('permission-denied'); }
final class NotFoundFailure extends AppFailure { const NotFoundFailure() : super('not-found'); }
final class CancelledFailure extends AppFailure { const CancelledFailure() : super('cancelled'); }
final class CacheFailure extends AppFailure { const CacheFailure(super.message); }
final class FirebaseFailure extends AppFailure { const FirebaseFailure(super.message); }

/// Validation carries a CODE, never display text: the UI localizes it.
enum ValidationCode { required, tooLong, invalidEmail, invalidPhone }
final class ValidationFailure extends AppFailure {
  const ValidationFailure(this.code) : super('validation');
  final ValidationCode code;
  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [message, code];
}
final class AuthFailure extends AppFailure {
  const AuthFailure(this.code) : super('auth/$code');
  final String code;
}
final class UnknownFailure extends AppFailure { const UnknownFailure(super.message); }

/// Thrown by datasources when the user dismisses a sign-in sheet; mapped to CancelledFailure.
final class CancelledException implements Exception { const CancelledException(); }

// app_logger.dart
abstract final class AppLogger {
  static void info(String m, {String? tag}) { if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('[${tag ?? 'App'}] $m'); }
  static void warning(String m) { if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('[Warning] $m'); }
  static void error(String m, {Object? error, StackTrace? stack}) {
    if (kDebugMode) debugPrint('[Error] $m: $error');
    if (error != null) unawaited(sl<ErrorReporter>().record(error, stack, reason: m));
  }
}

// error_reporter.dart
abstract interface class ErrorReporter {
  Future<void> record(Object error, StackTrace? stack, {bool fatal = false, String? reason});
  Future<void> recordFlutterError(FlutterErrorDetails details);
  Future<void> setUser(String? uid);
  Future<void> setKey(String key, Object value);
}

class CrashlyticsErrorReporter implements ErrorReporter {
  final _c = FirebaseCrashlytics.instance;
  @override Future<void> record(Object e, StackTrace? s, {bool fatal = false, String? reason}) => _c.recordError(e, s, fatal: fatal, reason: reason);
  @override Future<void> recordFlutterError(FlutterErrorDetails d) => _c.recordFlutterFatalError(d);
  @override Future<void> setUser(String? uid) => _c.setUserIdentifier(uid ?? '');
  @override Future<void> setKey(String k, Object v) => _c.setCustomKey(k, v);
}

class WebErrorReporter implements ErrorReporter {
  @override Future<void> record(Object e, StackTrace? s, {bool fatal = false, String? reason}) async => debugPrint('$reason $e\n$s');
  @override Future<void> recordFlutterError(FlutterErrorDetails d) async => FlutterError.dumpErrorToConsole(d);
  @override Future<void> setUser(String? uid) async {}
  @override Future<void> setKey(String k, Object v) async {}
}

// global_error_handlers.dart
Future<void> installGlobalErrorHandlers(ErrorReporter reporter) async {
  if (!kIsWeb) {
    await FirebaseCrashlytics.instance.setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(kReleaseMode && !AppConfig.instance.isDev);
  }
  FlutterError.onError = (details) {
    FlutterError.presentError(details);
    unawaited(reporter.recordFlutterError(details));
  };
  PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError = (error, stack) {
    unawaited(reporter.record(error, stack, fatal: true));
    return true;
  };
  if (!kIsWeb) {
    Isolate.current.addErrorListener(RawReceivePort((List<dynamic> pair) {
      unawaited(reporter.record(pair.first as Object, StackTrace.fromString(pair.last.toString()), fatal: true));
    }).sendPort);
  }
  ErrorWidget.builder = (details) =>
      kReleaseMode ? const FriendlyErrorWidget() : ErrorWidget(details.exception);
}

// exception_mapper.dart
extension FirebaseAuthExceptionX on FirebaseAuthException {
  AppFailure toFailure() => switch (code) {
        'invalid-credential' || 'wrong-password' || 'user-not-found' => const AuthFailure('invalid-credential'),
        'network-request-failed' => const NetworkFailure(),
        'web-context-cancelled' || 'popup-closed-by-user' => const CancelledFailure(),
        _ => AuthFailure(code),
      };
}
extension FirebaseExceptionX on FirebaseException {
  AppFailure toFailure() => switch (code) {
        'unavailable' || 'deadline-exceeded' => const NetworkFailure(),
        'permission-denied' || 'unauthenticated' => const PermissionFailure(), // incl. callable Functions
        'not-found' => const NotFoundFailure(),
        _ => FirebaseFailure(message ?? code),
      };
}

// failure_l10n.dart
extension AppFailureL10n on AppFailure {
  String localize(BuildContext context) {
    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    return switch (this) {
      NetworkFailure() => l.errorNoInternet,
      PermissionFailure() => l.errorNoPermission,
      NotFoundFailure() => l.errorNotFound,
      CancelledFailure() => '',
      ValidationFailure(:final code) => switch (code) {
          ValidationCode.required => l.validationRequired,
          ValidationCode.tooLong => l.validationTooLong,
          ValidationCode.invalidEmail => l.validationInvalidEmail,
          ValidationCode.invalidPhone => l.validationInvalidPhone,
        },
      AuthFailure(:final code) => switch (code) {
          'invalid-credential' => l.authInvalidCredential,
          'email-already-in-use' => l.authEmailInUse,
          'weak-password' => l.authWeakPassword,
          'too-many-requests' => l.authTooManyRequests,
          'user-disabled' => l.authUserDisabled,
          'requires-recent-login' => l.authRequiresRecentLogin,
          _ => l.errorGeneric,
        },
      FirebaseFailure() || CacheFailure() || UnknownFailure() => l.errorGeneric,
    };
  }
}

// error_view.dart
class ErrorView extends StatelessWidget {
  const ErrorView({super.key, required this.failure, this.onRetry});
  final AppFailure failure;
  final VoidCallback? onRetry;

  IconData get _icon => switch (failure) {
        NetworkFailure() => Icons.wifi_off_rounded,
        PermissionFailure() => Icons.lock_outline_rounded,
        NotFoundFailure() => Icons.search_off_rounded,
        _ => Icons.error_outline_rounded,
      };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final canRetry = onRetry != null && failure is! PermissionFailure && failure is! NotFoundFailure;
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
        child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
          Icon(_icon, size: 48, color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(failure.localize(context), textAlign: TextAlign.center, style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge),
          if (canRetry) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            FilledButton.tonalIcon(
              onPressed: onRetry,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
              label: Text(AppLocalizations.of(context).retry),
            ),
          ],
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// app_snack_bar.dart & friendly_error_widget.dart
abstract final class AppSnackBar {
  static void error(BuildContext context, String message) => _show(
        context, message, Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error, Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onError,
      );
  static void success(BuildContext context, String message) => _show(
        context, message, Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary, Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimary,
      );
  static void _show(BuildContext context, String msg, Color bg, Color fg) {
    if (msg.isEmpty) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(msg, style: TextStyle(color: fg)), backgroundColor: bg, behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating));
  }
}

class FriendlyErrorWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  const FriendlyErrorWidget({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cs = Theme.of(context).colorScheme; // falls back to the default theme above MaterialApp
    return ColoredBox(
      color: cs.surfaceContainerHighest,
      child: Center(child: Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 40, color: cs.onSurfaceVariant)),
    );
  }
}

4. Theme, Responsive Layouts & Localization (app_theme.dart, theme_cubit.dart, adaptive_scaffold.dart, locale_cubit.dart)

class AppTheme {
  static const _primary = Color(0xFF6366F1);
  static const _secondary = Color(0xFF818CF8);
  static const _error = Color(0xFFEF4444);

  static ThemeData get light => _build(const ColorScheme.light(
        primary: _primary, secondary: _secondary, surface: Color(0xFFFFFFFF), error: _error,
      ));
  static ThemeData get dark => _build(const ColorScheme.dark(
        primary: _primary, secondary: _secondary, surface: Color(0xFF1A1D2E), error: _error,
      ));

  static ThemeData _build(ColorScheme cs) => ThemeData(
        useMaterial3: true,
        colorScheme: cs,
        appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(elevation: 0, centerTitle: false),
        cardTheme: CardThemeData(
          elevation: 0,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        ),
      );
}

@lazySingleton
class ThemeCubit extends Cubit<ThemeMode> {
  ThemeCubit(this._prefs) : super(ThemeMode.values.elementAt(_prefs.getInt(_key) ?? 0));
  static const _key = 'theme_mode';
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  Future<void> setMode(ThemeMode mode) async {
    await _prefs.setInt(_key, mode.index);
    emit(mode);
  }
}

@lazySingleton
class LocaleCubit extends Cubit<Locale?> {
  LocaleCubit(this._prefs) : super(_read(_prefs));
  static const _key = 'locale_code';
  final SharedPreferences _prefs;
  static Locale? _read(SharedPreferences p) {
    final code = p.getString(_key);
    return code == null ? null : Locale(code);
  }
  Future<void> setLocale(Locale? locale) async {
    if (locale == null) {
      await _prefs.remove(_key);
    } else {
      await _prefs.setString(_key, locale.languageCode);
    }
    emit(locale);
  }
}

class ResponsiveLayout extends StatelessWidget {
  const ResponsiveLayout({super.key, required this.mobile, this.tablet, required this.desktop});
  final Widget mobile, desktop;
  final Widget? tablet;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => LayoutBuilder(builder: (_, c) {
        if (c.maxWidth >= 1024) return desktop;
        if (c.maxWidth >= 600) return tablet ?? desktop;
        return mobile;
      });
}

class AdaptiveScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  const AdaptiveScaffold({
    super.key,
    required this.selectedIndex,
    required this.onSelected,
    required this.destinations,
    required this.body,
  });
  final int selectedIndex;
  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;
  final List<NavigationDestination> destinations;
  final Widget body;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final wide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 600;
    return Scaffold(
      body: wide
          ? Row(children: [
              NavigationRail(
                selectedIndex: selectedIndex,
                onDestinationSelected: onSelected,
                destinations: [
                  for (final d in destinations)
                    NavigationRailDestination(icon: d.icon, selectedIcon: d.selectedIcon, label: Text(d.label)),
                ],
              ),
              const VerticalDivider(width: 1),
              Expanded(child: body),
            ])
          : body,
      bottomNavigationBar: wide
          ? null
          : NavigationBar(selectedIndex: selectedIndex, onDestinationSelected: onSelected, destinations: destinations),
    );
  }
}
  • RTL Rule: ALWAYS use EdgeInsetsDirectional, AlignmentDirectional, BorderRadiusDirectional, and Icons.arrow_back. Never EdgeInsets.only(left: ...) or right: ....

// lib/core/notifications/notification_channels.dart
class NotificationChannels {
  static const highImportance = AndroidNotificationChannel(
    'high_importance_channel',
    'High Importance Notifications',
    description: 'Board assignments, mentions & urgent tasks',
    importance: Importance.max,
    playSound: true,
    enableVibration: true,
  );
  static const low = AndroidNotificationChannel(
    'low_channel',
    'General Updates',
    description: 'Comments, board updates & reminders',
    importance: Importance.defaultImportance,
  );

  static Future<void> register(FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin plugin) async {
    final android = plugin.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>();
    await android?.createNotificationChannel(highImportance);
    await android?.createNotificationChannel(low);
  }
}

// lib/core/notifications/local_notification_service.dart
@lazySingleton
class LocalNotificationService {
  final _plugin = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();

  Future<void> init() async {
    const initSettings = InitializationSettings(
      android: AndroidInitializationSettings('@drawable/ic_notification'),
      iOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
        requestAlertPermission: false,
        requestBadgePermission: false,
        requestSoundPermission: false,
      ),
    );
    // flutter_local_notifications >= 20: named parameters
    await _plugin.initialize(settings: initSettings, onDidReceiveNotificationResponse: _onTap);
    await NotificationChannels.register(_plugin);
  }

  Future<void> show({
    required int id,
    required String title,
    required String body,
    String? payload,
    bool highPriority = true,
  }) async {
    final channel = highPriority ? NotificationChannels.highImportance : NotificationChannels.low;
    final details = NotificationDetails(
      android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
        channel.id, channel.name,
        channelDescription: channel.description,
        importance: channel.importance,
        priority: Priority.high,
        icon: '@drawable/ic_notification',
        styleInformation: BigTextStyleInformation(body),
      ),
      iOS: const DarwinNotificationDetails(presentAlert: true, presentBadge: true, presentSound: true),
    );
    await _plugin.show(id: id, title: title, body: body, notificationDetails: details, payload: payload);
  }

  void _onTap(NotificationResponse response) {
    if (response.payload == null) return;
    NotificationNavigator.navigateFromPayload(response.payload!);
  }
}

// lib/app.dart
class App extends StatefulWidget {
  const App({super.key});
  @override
  State<App> createState() => _AppState();
}

class _AppState extends State<App> {
  final _messengerKey = GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState>();
  late final StreamSubscription<AppFailure> _writeErrorSub;
  late final AuthBloc _authBloc = sl<AuthBloc>();
  late final FeatureFlagsCubit _flags = sl<FeatureFlagsCubit>();
  late final ThemeCubit _themeCubit = sl<ThemeCubit>();
  late final LocaleCubit _localeCubit = sl<LocaleCubit>();
  late final ConnectivityCubit _connectivity = sl<ConnectivityCubit>();
  late final GoRouter _router = createAppRouter(authBloc: _authBloc, flags: _flags);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    AppNavigator.router = _router;
    _writeErrorSub = sl<WriteErrorBus>().stream.listen(_showWriteError);
    unawaited(_openFromTerminatedNotification());
  }

  /// Offline-first writes rejected by the server (rules / App Check) surface here.
  void _showWriteError(AppFailure failure) {
    final messenger = _messengerKey.currentState;
    final ctx = _messengerKey.currentContext;
    if (messenger == null || ctx == null) return;
    final cs = Theme.of(ctx).colorScheme;
    messenger
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(
        content: Text(AppLocalizations.of(ctx).errorWriteRejected, style: TextStyle(color: cs.onError)),
        backgroundColor: cs.error,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      ));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    unawaited(_writeErrorSub.cancel());
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _openFromTerminatedNotification() async {
    final message = await FirebaseMessaging.instance.getInitialMessage();
    if (message == null || !mounted) return;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback(
      (_) => NotificationNavigator.navigate(message.data),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MultiBlocProvider(
      providers: [
        BlocProvider.value(value: _authBloc),
        BlocProvider.value(value: _flags),
        BlocProvider.value(value: _themeCubit),
        BlocProvider.value(value: _localeCubit),
        BlocProvider.value(value: _connectivity),
      ],
      child: BlocBuilder<ThemeCubit, ThemeMode>(
        builder: (context, themeMode) => BlocBuilder<LocaleCubit, Locale?>(
          builder: (context, locale) => MaterialApp.router(
            title: AppConfig.instance.appName,
            theme: AppTheme.light,
            darkTheme: AppTheme.dark,
            themeMode: themeMode,
            locale: locale,
            localizationsDelegates: AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
            supportedLocales: AppLocalizations.supportedLocales,
            routerConfig: _router,
            scaffoldMessengerKey: _messengerKey,
            builder: (context, child) {
              final app = Column(children: [const OfflineBanner(), Expanded(child: child!)]);
              return AppConfig.instance.isProd
                  ? app
                  : Banner(
                      message: AppConfig.instance.isDev ? 'DEV' : 'STG',
                      location: BannerLocation.topEnd,
                      color: AppConfig.instance.isDev ? Colors.orange : Colors.purple,
                      child: app,
                    );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/core/notifications/fcm_service.dart
@lazySingleton
class FcmService {
  FcmService(this._messaging, this._firestore, this._local);
  final FirebaseMessaging _messaging;
  final FirebaseFirestore _firestore;
  final LocalNotificationService _local;

  StreamSubscription<String>? _tokenSub;
  StreamSubscription<RemoteMessage>? _fgSub, _tapSub;
  String? _activeUserId;

  Future<void> initialize(String userId) async {
    if (_activeUserId == userId) return;
    dispose();
    _activeUserId = userId;

    if (!kIsWeb) await _local.init();
    final settings = await _messaging.requestPermission(provisional: true);
    AppLogger.info('FCM permission: ${settings.authorizationStatus}', tag: 'FCM');
    if (settings.authorizationStatus == AuthorizationStatus.denied) {
      await _firestore.collection('users').doc(userId).set(
        {'notificationsEnabled': false},
        SetOptions(merge: true),
      );
      return;
    }

    final token = await _messaging.getToken(
      vapidKey: kIsWeb ? AppConfig.instance.webVapidKey : null,
    );
    if (token != null) await _saveToken(userId, token);

    _tokenSub = _messaging.onTokenRefresh.listen(
      (t) => _saveToken(userId, t),
      onError: (Object e, StackTrace s) => AppLogger.error('Token refresh error', error: e, stack: s),
    );
    _fgSub = FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen(_handleForeground);
    _tapSub = FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((m) => NotificationNavigator.navigate(m.data));
  }

  Future<void> _handleForeground(RemoteMessage m) async {
    final n = m.notification;
    if (n == null || kIsWeb) return;
    await _local.show(
      id: (m.messageId ?? '${m.sentTime}').hashCode & 0x7fffffff, // stable 31-bit id
      title: n.title ?? '',
      body: n.body ?? '',
      payload: jsonEncode(m.data),
      highPriority: m.data['priority'] == 'high',
    );
    if (await AppBadgePlus.isSupported()) {
      final current = await AppBadgePlus.getBadgeCount();
      await AppBadgePlus.updateBadge(current + 1);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveToken(String uid, String token) =>
      _firestore.collection('users').doc(uid).set({
        'fcmTokens': FieldValue.arrayUnion([token]),
        'notificationsEnabled': true,
        'lastTokenUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));

  /// Call BEFORE signing out (the write needs auth). Best effort: never block sign-out.
  Future<void> removeToken(String uid) async {
    try {
      final t = await _messaging.getToken(vapidKey: kIsWeb ? AppConfig.instance.webVapidKey : null);
      if (t != null) {
        await _firestore.collection('users').doc(uid).update({
          'fcmTokens': FieldValue.arrayRemove([t]),
        }).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
      }
    } catch (e, s) {
      AppLogger.error('removeToken failed', error: e, stack: s);
    }
    await deleteLocalToken();
  }

  /// After account deletion the user doc is gone; only invalidate the device token.
  Future<void> deleteLocalToken() async {
    try {
      await _messaging.deleteToken();
    } catch (e, s) {
      AppLogger.error('deleteToken failed', error: e, stack: s);
    }
  }

  Future<void> clearBadge() async {
    if (!kIsWeb && await AppBadgePlus.isSupported()) await AppBadgePlus.updateBadge(0);
  }

  void dispose() {
    unawaited(_tokenSub?.cancel());
    unawaited(_fgSub?.cancel());
    unawaited(_tapSub?.cancel());
    _tokenSub = _fgSub = _tapSub = null;
    _activeUserId = null;
  }
}

// lib/core/notifications/notification_navigator.dart
abstract final class NotificationNavigator {
  static void navigateFromPayload(String payload) {
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(payload);
      if (decoded is Map<String, dynamic>) navigate(decoded);
    } catch (e, s) {
      AppLogger.error('Invalid notification payload', error: e, stack: s);
    }
  }

  static void navigate(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final type = data['type'] as String?;
    final id = data['id'] as String?;
    final boardId = data['boardId'] as String?;
    switch (type) {
      case 'board_invite':
        if (id != null) AppNavigator.go(RouteNames.boardPath(id));
      case 'card_assigned' || 'comment_added':
        if (boardId != null) AppNavigator.go(RouteNames.boardPath(boardId));
      default:
        AppNavigator.go(RouteNames.notifications);
    }
  }
}

enum NotificationsStatus { initial, loading, success, failure }

class NotificationsState extends Equatable {
  const NotificationsState({
    this.status = NotificationsStatus.initial,
    this.notifications = const [],
    this.unreadCount = 0,
    this.failure,
  });
  final NotificationsStatus status;
  final List<NotificationEntity> notifications;
  final int unreadCount;
  final AppFailure? failure;

  NotificationsState copyWith({
    NotificationsStatus? status,
    List<NotificationEntity>? notifications,
    int? unreadCount,
    AppFailure? Function()? failure,
  }) =>
      NotificationsState(
        status: status ?? this.status,
        notifications: notifications ?? this.notifications,
        unreadCount: unreadCount ?? this.unreadCount,
        failure: failure != null ? failure() : this.failure,
      );

  @override
  List<Object?> get props => [status, notifications, unreadCount, failure];
}
